name: I/35 Valdštejnsko → Čímyšl

official.note: The OSM highway=proposed line of the I/35 Turnov – Úlibice (proposed=trunk, ref 35; the E1 line of the 2021 EIA opinion, 33.0 km as the 2023 ŘSD technical study), from the D10/I/35 at Ohrazenice through the Pelešany tunnel to where the D35 Úlibice bypass starts (research/89).

A.note: Valdštejnsko: 6.4 km along the mapped line, past the Valdštejnsko interchange, the railway and road I/35 (km 5.48 / 5.51) and road III/2835 (km 6.13): the stage from Turnov ends here

B.note: Čímyšl: at the Čímyšl interchange (OSM ramp at km 18.9), the end of stage Valdštejnsko – Čímyšl (≈ 12.5 km)

baselineNote: Planned, not built (ŘSD: new EIA from 2026, works from about 2032; research/89). The planned line is OSM highway=proposed, outside the road network. Ground depths are uncalibrated regional priors.
